sourceDesc.p: Mary Behrend's note's and drawing in a calendar

figure.figDesc: Stylised way of writing the date. Big green "m" stamp for march to go along with St. Paddy's. Snakes go around the date.
figure.p: Saint Patrick was a useful saint
He freightened all the snakes away-
I wish he'd try his art on smoke
figure.figDesc: 3-leaf clovers surrond the text and below said text is a rendetion of the Hammermill factory. The building has a falt roofed part, then a sloped roof,then two smokestacks that billow smoke, and finally one more flat roofed area.
Stylised red stamp for the "m" of march
figure.p: Molly on snowshoes That Mr. Weir Got. Pretty Picture Is it Not?
figure.figDesc: A rendition of Marry Behrend with rosy cheeks, some sort of headwear, gloves, a jacket, and massive cartoonish snow shoes.
